text:
Maya: Quick status check — are the dashboard and trace hook owners aligned for the console observability cutover? We have the retention milestone next Friday and I want the handoff clear.

Sam: We're mostly set but need to confirm owners for the error-analysis views. I thought @Leo would take the primary on dashboards, and @Riyah on trace hooks. Is that still the plan?

Leo: Yep I'll own dashboard rollouts and visual queries. I'll need a short checklist from Sam on which panels are mandatory for the cutover (latency P50/P95, error-rate, req-rate).

Sam: Sending checklist now, but two quick asks:
- confirm trace hook PRs are merged and deployed to staging
- decide whether to keep 30d traces or extend to 90d for the retention milestone

Riyah: Trace hooks PRs are mostly in. PRs: https://git.redwood/observability/pulls/4567 and /4572. deploy-bot ran a staging deploy yesterday but we hit a schema mismatch on span tags in /4572.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for observability service @ 2026-03-10T04:12Z (build 2026.03.10.4). Rollback auto-scheduled for failing migrations.

Leo: For dashboards checklist — minimal panels are: latency P50/P95, error-rate by service, top error traces, user-impact heatmap. I can add the anomaly detector once the traces are stable.

Maya: On retention: product prefers 90d for trace correlation across releases, but cost team flagged higher storage. Sam, any estimate delta?

Sam: Ballpark: 30d -> 90d is ~2.8x storage for spans. We can mitigate with sampling and cold-tiering. Proposal: keep full traces 30d, archive sampled traces to 90d for correlation. That keeps most query features and lowers cost.

Riyah: That pattern works operationally. We can add a conditional sampler that keeps full traces for errors and high-latency requests, archive the rest.

Leo: Ok I'll implement dashboard toggles for full vs sampled queries and expose a flag so we can flip in runtime without rollout.

Maya: Ownership call: Leo owns dashboards, Riyah owns trace hooks + sampling, Sam owns error analysis views and retention config. Can everyone confirm?

Sam: Confirmed.

Leo: Confirmed.

Riyah: Confirmed. I'll fix the /4572 span tag schema, aim to land by EOD. If it's blocked I'll open a patch and ping @Leo.

Maya: Great. Next steps: Riyah lands hooks, Sam finalizes retention config doc, Leo wires dashboard toggles. Let's aim for a staging canary on Wednesday. If anything blocks, post updates here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary scheduled for observability on 2026-03-11T09:00Z.

Maya: Thanks — please add PR links in this thread when ready so I can update the roadmap doc.
